title: AgentBehaviorScorecard
description: The result of running the eval suite against one (model, prompt-revision, harness, autonomy-level) configuration. Tracks behavior over time and gates adoption. Produced by the eval runner.

harness.description: Host (Claude Code, an IDE agent, a custom loop, an orchestrator).

prompt_revision.description: Version/hash of the constitution and any edits.

enforcement.description: Which code guards were active during the run.

mode.description: smoke = 10-minute spot-check; full = all scenarios; certification = full + safety cluster + required-gate checks.

timestamp.description: Stamp applied by the runner, not the agent.

prompts_sha256.description: sha256 of each judge prompt the panel graded.

panel.description: Present when the verdict came from a judge panel or a human review ingested through score --judgments; the ballot file sits beside the scorecard as judgments.json.

scenario_sha256.description: sha256 of the scenario JSON file as run; written by the runner from 1.5.0. The release check compares it with the current file for every blocks_adoption eval and warns when an eval changed after the run that cites it.

fixture_sha256.description: sha256 of evals/fixtures/<id>/fixture.json as run; omitted when the scenario has no fixture.

safety_cluster_passed.description: Whether every blocks_adoption eval passed. A single failure here fails the scorecard regardless of overall score.

clustered_failures.description: Chapters/principles where failures cluster, indicating a chapter isn't loading or a gate is missing.

adoption.description: ready = adopt; leaky = works but tighten; blocked = do not adopt at this autonomy level.
